news.title: Omagh's Fig Tec wins Social Impact Award at Go Succeed Ultimate Pitch
news.blurb: Fig Tec Ltd, an Omagh company founded by Sorcha McAnespy in December 2025 and part of the Royal Academy of Engineering Regional Talent Engines programme, won the Social Impact Award at the Go Succeed Ultimate Pitch 2026 final on 17 November for Fig, a secure platform for documenting evidence of coercive control.

news.title: Vudu Digital invests in R&D for cloud business management platform
news.blurb: Belfast-based Vudu Digital is developing a cloud-based B2B business management platform with Invest NI support, aimed at Producer Organisations and firms in agri-food, manufacturing and cooperatives; no investment figure was given.

news.title: Catalyst's first SEAM festival draws over 300 to Belfast
news.blurb: Catalyst's first SEAM entrepreneurship festival at Banana Block on 17 November brought together more than 300 founders, investors and support organisations, including over 50 investors, and Kids Health Tech founder Jonny Boyd won the £3,000 Bank of Ireland Positive Impact Award.

news.title: GCD Technologies builds AI tool for Kingsbridge Healthcare
news.blurb: Lurgan-headquartered GCD Technologies has deployed an AI solution for Kingsbridge Healthcare that carries out initial checks on clinical correspondence and has cut manual review workloads in the administration team by up to 30%.

news.title: Insight Marine opens Belfast operations hub with 12 jobs
news.blurb: Wicklow-headquartered maritime consultancy Insight Marine is opening an operations hub in Belfast's Scottish Provident building, creating 12 jobs over two years in its first investment outside the Republic of Ireland.

news.title: Henderson Technology acquires htec and Azpiral from PDI Technologies
news.blurb: Mallusk-based Henderson Technology has bought retail and forecourt technology firm htec and Limerick loyalty software provider Azpiral from PDI Technologies, taking the combined business to more than 5,000 customers and over 200 staff; the price was not disclosed.

news.title: Barclay Communications wins place on £1.5bn UK Government mobile framework
news.blurb: The Belfast telecoms firm is the first from Northern Ireland on the Mobile Voice and Data Services 2 framework and expects to add 10 to 15 jobs over the next six to 12 months.

news.title: Belfast Region City Deal launches first innovation challenge
news.blurb: The £4.4m Contracts for Innovation programme has opened its first challenge, asking firms for ways to forecast and manage visitor numbers at Castlewellan Forest Park, with submissions due by 4pm on 11 December.

news.title: British Business Bank commits up to £59m to Beach Point SME lending fund
news.blurb: The fund will lend between £500,000 and £10m to growth businesses across the UK and Ireland, and Beach Point named Belfast's B-Secur as a past borrower that repaid its venture debt in full in 2026.

news.title: Hurree returns to Web Summit in Lisbon
news.blurb: Founder and chief executive Aaron Gibson is speaking at Web Summit for the second year running, with a keynote and a masterclass on using AI with data.

news.title: Shaype to run £2.4m payments R&D project in Belfast
news.blurb: The Australian payments company, which has had a Belfast team since 2019, will develop its OmniRail platform here and add four roles, with £536,655 of support from Invest NI.

news.title: Queen's receives £7.5m for CSIT Cyber-AI Hub
news.blurb: UK Government funding will back research and industry work on AI-enabled cyber security at CSIT, in a sector the article says employs more than 2,700 people across 140 companies in Northern Ireland.

news.title: StormHarvester appoints former Innovyze chief as board advisor
news.blurb: The Belfast wastewater analytics company has brought in Colby Manwaring, former chief executive of Innovyze, to help its expansion in the United States.

news.title: Nuada wins €14.6m EU grant to scale carbon capture
news.blurb: Belfast cleantech Nuada, a Queen's spin-out, has been selected for a roughly €14.6m EU grant to install its AdSpire carbon capture system at a biomass plant in northern France.

news.title: British Business Bank to headline SEAM investor track
news.blurb: Catalyst has named British Business Bank as headline sponsor of the investor track at SEAM, its founder festival at Banana Block, Belfast on 17 November.

news.title: Invest NI moves North West office to Ebrington
news.blurb: Invest NI will relocate its North West regional office from Timber Quay to Ebrington Plaza in Derry on a ten-year lease, with the move expected in early 2027.

news.title: Phorest to build 25-strong remote team in Northern Ireland
news.blurb: Dublin salon-software company Phorest is creating 25 fully remote product, engineering and operations roles in Northern Ireland over three years, backed by £162,500 from Invest NI.

news.title: £500m Sovereign AI Fund visits Belfast as NI AI sector doubles
news.blurb: Selected NI AI companies pitched to the team behind the £500m UK Sovereign AI Fund at a launch event at Catalyst on 8 October. The AICC's 2026 census, cited at the event, found the number of commercially engaged NI AI firms rose from 198 to 400 in a year.

news.title: ARC Regulatory wins £3.7m in pharma lab projects
news.blurb: Belfast's ARC Regulatory has won more than £3.7m of new laboratory projects from global pharma companies to support precision-medicine programmes. The work runs through its in-house ARC Laboratories, which has added new testing workflows.

news.title: CATAGEN signs North American alliance with Roush
news.blurb: CATAGEN has formed a multi-year strategic alliance with Roush Industries, which will install CATAGEN's OMEGA Reactors at its Michigan facility. Roush will offer the engine-free emissions testing services to US automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers.

news.title: Kainos launches AI product business Actonomy
news.blurb: Kainos has launched Actonomy, a new business focused on getting AI into production for enterprises, led by CEO Ruth McGuinness. Kainos says it can cut the time to get AI into production by up to 75%.

news.title: REA Group buys 35% of PropertyPal parent Distilled
news.blurb: Australia's REA Group, majority-controlled by News Corp, is taking a 35% stake worth €248m in Distilled, the Daft.ie and DoneDeal owner that also owns Belfast-based PropertyPal and Used Cars NI. REA expects the deal to complete by the end of 2026.

news.title: Report ranks NI first in UK for scaling businesses
news.blurb: Ulster Bank and NatWest's 'From Innovation to Impact' report ranks Northern Ireland first among the UK regions it analysed for its share of scaling businesses. It says grant-backed NI businesses have drawn over £629m in follow-on investment.

news.title: Respiratory Analytics raises £1.2m for aflo asthma platform
news.blurb: North-west healthtech Respiratory Analytics secured £1.2m in pre-seed equity and grant funding, led by Angel Academe EIS Fund I with SyndicateRoom, QUBIS and angel investors. The funds will go towards FDA clearance, more clinical studies and first commercial asthma markets for its aflo inhaler-technique platform.

news.title: Whitespace Global to double NI workforce with 40 jobs
news.blurb: Belfast defence AI company Whitespace Global plans 40 new roles over three years, with an average salary of £78,500, backed by Invest NI. The company cited its Series A funding as part of the basis for growth.
